# Markdown Instructions

## Conventions
- Use standard GitHub Flavored Markdown with clean headings (`#`, `##`, `###`).
- For architectural diagrams, data flows, and state machines, use Mermaid syntax blocks (````mermaid ... ````) along with clean ASCII fallbacks.
- Organize technical notes with:
  - Intent / Concept overview
  - Problem statement & Real-world analogy
  - Visual Architecture / Data flow diagram
  - Component responsibilities & Framework mapping
  - Interview relevance and edge cases / common pitfalls
- Keep sentences concise, bullet points structured, and use markdown tables for comparisons.
